summary: John's 8th-great-grandfather (if the Doll link holds); of Ulmet, Kusel district.
bio: Christoffel Doll (1671-1739) and Anna Sara Schuch of Ulmet were the parents of Johann Casper Doll. A 'Stoffel Doll, 40' on the 1739 Samuel is a different (younger) man. Earlier Dolls of Erzweiler, in Ulmet parish - Abraham Doll (d. 4 Nov 1651, Erzweiler), Peter Doll (c.1611-1688, Erzweiler) and Elisabetha Margaretha Doll (bapt. Ulmet 1652) - are in GEDBAS file 20942 but their link to Christoffel is not shown (speculative). A Maria Engel Doll, b. 15 Sep 1717 at Ulmet, d. 1785, married Jacob Sorber in 1739 (possibly Casper's sister; speculative).
sources: WikiTree Doll-527 (Johann Casper Doll; FamilySearch N5BL-88G): https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Doll-527
